Supreme Court hears plea against organizers of student protests

The Supreme Court, led by Justice Surya Kant, agreed to hear a petition concerning the role of organizers in student protests. The court questioned whether individuals with criminal histories should be protected under the guise of student demonstrations. Justice Surya Kant also remarked that the state government could withdraw FIRs, and the court would decide on the use of pellet guns.
